summary: Standard breakdown for a gear reducer: 3 sub-assemblies.

subassemblies.name: Housing
subassemblies.description: The casing that carries the bearings, seals and mounting feet.

parts.name: Housing base
parts.description: Lower casing with bearing bores, mounting feet and an oil drain.

parts.name: Housing cover
parts.description: Upper casing matching the base split line, with a breather boss.

parts.name: Bearing cap
parts.description: Bolted cap that locates the outer bearing ring.

parts.name: Cover bolt
parts.description: Hex bolts clamping the cover to the base.

subassemblies.name: Input stage
subassemblies.description: The fast shaft with its pinion and bearings.

parts.name: Input shaft
parts.description: Stepped shaft with bearing seats and a keyed coupling end.

parts.name: Pinion
parts.description: Spur pinion on the input shaft.

parts.name: Input bearing
parts.description: Deep-groove ball bearings supporting the input shaft.

subassemblies.name: Output stage
subassemblies.description: The slow shaft with its gear and bearings.

parts.name: Output shaft
parts.description: Stepped shaft with bearing seats, gear seat and a keyed output end.

parts.name: Output gear
parts.description: Spur gear meshing with the pinion, keyed to the output shaft.

parts.name: Output bearing
parts.description: Deep-groove ball bearings supporting the output shaft.
